founder.label: About the Founder
founder.cardNote: Designing film posters, title logos and typography for Telugu cinema.
paragraphs: Sasank Muppalla is the founder and creative director of Dolly Design Studio, designing film posters, title logos and typography from Bangalore.
His work has taken him across production houses such as Annapurna Studios, Arka Media Works and People Media Factory, and filmmakers and actors including Adivi Sesh and Varun Tej.

projects.title: Dacoit
projects.brief: Betrayed by his better half, a man is convicted for a crime he didn’t commit. Once free, he hunts her down in pursuit of vengeance, as their stories intertwine with a series of robberies. The campaign had to hold romance and rage in the same frame.

credits.label: Genre
credits.value: Action, Drama, Romantic Thriller · UA13+ · 2h 32m · Released 10 Apr 2026

credits.label: Writers
credits.value: Adivi Sesh · Abburi Ravi · Yash Eshwari · Shaneil Deo

projects.title: G2
projects.client: People Media Factory · Abhishek Agarwal Arts
projects.brief: Six years after ‘Goodachari’, G2 follows Agent Gopi on a global mission uncovering truths about his past, with patriotism, sacrifice and thrilling twists across five countries. The campaign leans into cold steel, shattered glass and a barcode title that feels like classified intel.

credits.label: Cast
credits.value: Adivi Sesh · Emraan Hashmi · Wamiqa Gabbi

credits.label: Studios
credits.value: People Media Factory · Abhishek Agarwal Arts · AK Entertainments

images.alt: G2 poster — Adivi Sesh aiming through shattered glass
G2 release poster — red-tinted faces, ‘May 1st 2026 worldwide release’
G2 poster — the leads walking in a European city square at sunset
G2 character poster — Emraan Hashmi in dark glasses

projects.title: Baahubali: The Epic
projects.brief: A legendary warrior emerges from humble beginnings to challenge powerful forces threatening his homeland, as ancient prophecies and family bonds shape his journey. The re-release artwork had to feel monumental and new without losing the grandeur audiences remember.

images.alt: Baahubali: The Epic ensemble poster with the kingdom’s characters
Baahubali: The Epic poster — Prabhas crowned, ‘31 October 2025’
Baahubali: The Epic poster — warrior in battle armour, ‘Oct 31 2025’

projects.brief: A couple’s perfect marriage, following their cute first meeting, is tested when the wife grows suspicious of her husband’s odd conduct, leading to a revelation that transforms their view of love. A bright, playful comedy that needed a title with a wink.

projects.brief: A 50-year-old corporate executive battling depression finds healing and redemption through reconnecting with her 80-year-old mother, discovering that parental love can restore what ambition has broken. Soft daylight, handwritten type, and a lot of warmth.
